method.aggregates: counted runs of units with confidence in ['high', 'medium']; a run counts when content binds it to the declared revision or the run set gives a binding_accept reason
method.cross: rows right or wrong against whether any record of the unit was opened in that run
method.not_counted_as_opened: a container read whose result spilled to a file and never showed the text
method.opened: a tool result shows the record's own text (a 40-character window after its first 100 characters, the whole text when shorter, or the unit's needles; Gmail bodies decoded from base64), or a read call names the record's id and its result spilled to a file, or, for a record without a text needle, a result holds an object with its id and a content field
method.rows_right: every rubric row of the unit passed in that run (baseline runs with stored results only)
method.snippet_only: only the id or the first 40 characters were seen; not counted as opened
